info.title: PulseRecover API
info.description: AI Payment Reliability & Revenue Recovery Engine. Probabilistic AI proposes, deterministic policy decides, payment infrastructure executes, verification proves. All money amounts are integer paise (INR).

post.description:
Run (or return) an AI investigation for an incident.

Runs the diagnosis first when none exists, then the reasoner, persists the
run in ``agent_reports`` and audits it. With ``force_refresh`` a fresh
report is produced even if one already exists.

get.description: Latest completed investigation report for an incident.

post.description:
Execute one detection pass over payment_events and persist incidents.

Re-running with the same window/segment/detector updates the existing
incident instead of duplicating it. ``dry_run`` computes everything but
persists nothing.

get.description: Aggregate over COMPLETED stored runs (means of available values).

post.description:
Idempotently turn an incident's failed payments + abandoned checkouts
into opportunities, and generate each opportunity's strategy set.

Operator-triggered reconciliation sweep (ADR 0011): UNKNOWN actions are
re-queried against gateway truth (GETs only) and failed webhook events are
re-run through the same handler registry as live intake. Idempotent.
